youtube_title: Police, Fire or Ambulance? Just Dial 112. Rules You Didn't Know #25 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #25. You see an accident: which number do you call? 112 is India's single emergency number for police, fire and ambulance. In May 2026 the Supreme Court directed every state and UT to make 112 fully functional within three months, and 100, 101 and 108 are being merged into it. Where it isn't merged yet, 108 still works. The 112 India app has an SOS button that shares your location.
Source: 112.gov.in; Supreme Court order, May 2026.
